It's almost been a week since Clipped was released on steam and already people are speedrunning it, this is for those people.

There is not an [b]in game timer[/b] and by popular request an [b]in game fall counter[/b] aswell.

DLC will be releasing in the future - stay tuned.

notes.title: Clipped 1.0
notes.content: I've gotten some feedback from the community that found a couple of bugs, first of all thank you for downloading the game and reporting them, I got to fixing them asap, and here we are, the first update to Clipped! Clipped 1.0

notes.title: New area!
notes.content:
Big Tower is a semi symmetrical tower that makes you wonder which way to go, left or right? You'll become very familiar with this tower and its shapes since it will help you fall back down to the bottom where you belong. Flightless and afraid, this tower will ruin your day, anyone who enters have already fallen.
